segments.sn12.34:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“sattasattari vo, bhikkhave, ñāṇavatthūni desessāmi.
segments.sn12.34:1.3: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.sn12.34:1.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.sn12.34:2.4: atītampi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.34:2.5: anāgatampi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.34:2.6: yampissa taṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tampi khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammanti ñāṇaṃ.
segments.sn12.34:3.1: “Bhavapaccayā jātīti ñāṇaṃ … pe … upādānapaccayā bhavoti ñāṇaṃ … taṇhāpaccayā upādānanti ñāṇaṃ … vedanāpaccayā taṇhāti ñāṇaṃ … phassapaccayā vedanāti ñāṇaṃ … saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti ñāṇaṃ … nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatananti ñāṇaṃ … viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti ñāṇaṃ … saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇanti ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.34:3.10: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.34:3.11: atītampi addhānaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.34:3.12: anāgatampi addhānaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.34:3.13: yampissa taṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tampi khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammanti ñāṇaṃ.

lines: Byañjanabhāṇakā kira te bhikkhū, bahubyañjanaṃ katvā vuccamāne paṭivijjhituṃ sakkonti, tasmā tesaṃ ajjhāsayena idaṃ suttaṃ vuttaṃ.
Paccayākāro hi dhammānaṃ pavattiṭṭhitikāraṇattā dhammaṭṭhitīti vuccati, ettha ñāṇaṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ, etasseva chabbidhassa ñāṇassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Sattasattarīti ekekasmiṃ satta satta katvā ekādasasu padesu sattasattari.
Tiṭṭhati tattha phalaṃ tadāyattavuttitāyāti ṭhiti, paccuppannalakkhaṇassa dhammassa ṭhiti dhammaṭṭhiti.
Atha vā dhammoti kāraṇaṃ, paccayoti attho.
Dhammassa yo ṭhitisabhāvo, sova dhammato añño natthīti dhammaṭṭhiti, paccayo.
Tasmā idhāpi dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ vipassanāti gahetvā “vipassanāpaṭivipassanā kathitā”ti vuttaṃ.
